body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: 5 Cursor specialists in parallel + generic Codex.

Round 1 results: 6 reviewers (5 Cursor specialists + 1 Codex). Accepted fixes: narrowed progress-reporting.md to apply skill_path only to 🔶 start lines (not all icon types), reverted completion/skip examples, fixed compact-format grammar, fixed flags.md ambiguous parenthetical. Round classified non-substantial (minor spec clarification, no high-severity bugs). Converged after 1 round.
